name: LV-Eval
description: LV-Eval is a long-context benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on single-hop and multi-hop question answering tasks across five context length levels up to 256k tokens, incorporating techniques to mitigate knowledge leakage and improve metric accuracy.
reputation: A specialized long-context benchmark from the recent literature that has seen some attention, but it is not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Features bilingual datasets with confusing facts insertion and keyword-recall-based metrics to provide balanced and objective evaluation of long-context LLM capabilities.
